In addition to the other special inspection requirements of this code, special inspections of structural steel seismic force resistancing systems and structural steel elements shall be performed in accordance with Sections 1705.2.4.1 and 1705.2.4.2.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
